A killed Sputnik scores 4× the ICBM value. SPUTKI loads X=3 and jumps to the shared multiple-score routine (GEKILL), which awards X+1 = 4 units — the line's own comment reads '(4X ICBM)'. Derived as the LDX I,3 immediate + 1, mirroring MC-MIRV-MAX's inclusive-loop derivation.

source.verbatim: LDX I,3			;SUB. GIVE MULTIPLE SCORE (4X ICBM)

meaning: Per-salvo Sputnik launch cap = 3. SPUTFIR (W3MAIN.MAC:2703) falls into MIRVER, whose POTENT clamp CMP I,2 / IFCS / LDA I,2 / STA POTENT ('NO MORE THAN 3 SHOTS FROM A MIRV', W3MAIN.MAC:2717) saturates the shot budget at the immediate 2 — an inclusive 0..2 count, so operand+1 = 3 shots, the same derivation as MC-SPUT-SCORE's LDX I,3 → 4 and MC-MIRV-MAX's LDA I,2 → 3. The former cite (ICNORM's CPX I,4, :2475) is the NORMAL-swarm launch cap, not the SPUTFIR salvo's.
